observations.summary: Reuters reported three knowledgeable sources confirming an attack on ship-navigation systems at Didamar in the Strait of Hormuz, following an Iranian claim on November 10. Reuters verified video of smoke and noted Copernicus thermal activity, but could not establish whether navigation equipment was destroyed or quantify damage. Other maritime sources assessed limited shipping impact because alternative systems exist. This is new corroboration of an earlier claim, not evidence of a new attack after the prior scan.
observations.title: Reuters sources corroborate reported Iranian strike on navigation infrastructure at Oman's Didamar island
